reviews.x: I purchased this for Halloween (coming up next month). We decided to take it out and give it a try. Both my grandkids love it - boy age 9 and girl age 4. It is not messy, the colors glide on smoothly and it was easy to clean up. It washes out well and did not transfer (or stain) the kids’ clothes. I can think of lots of themed occasions to use these throughout the year.

This hair chalk is so much fun! I was surprised how easy it was to apply. I got my hair a little bit wet and just rubbed it on. It stayed in my hair for two days until I washed it, then it came right out. I wore white while wearing it and didn’t see it come off on to my clothes.  There was some on my pillow when waking up in the morning.

I purchased these for my daughters upcoming birthday party.  I wanted to make sure that they were easy to use for 8/9 year olds, were pretty color wise, and easy to remove.  The glittery colors were beautiful and they were super easy to remove.  We are excited to be able to use them for her birthday sleepover and for Halloween!

My 6 year old daughter loves this hair chalk! She’s been begging me for pink highlights, and I refuse to dye her hair this young. This hair chalk was the perfect solution! She has dirty blonde hair and the colors show up great! The lighter colors need a couple applications depending on how bright you want it be. Super easy application, and washes right out with shampoo. I definitely recommend this product!

She was very happy with her colorful hair.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the hair chalk as easy to apply and fun for kids, with many citing smooth application and enjoyment by children.
Many reviewers report the color washes out easily and does not stain or transfer onto clothes.
Several reviewers praise the color payoff, noting it shows up well even on dark or black hair and offers good color saturation.
A few reviewers describe the product as messy or hard to use, with some reporting staining of skin and clothing.
Some reviewers note results vary by hair type, with lighter colors needing multiple applications and results being less satisfying for long or thick hair.
